notes:
### 新功能

- JSON 工具新增「查看器」：几百 MB、上 GB 的 JSON 文件也能几秒打开，树形浏览、键盘操作、Ctrl+C 复制。可以打开文件、把文件拖进来、读剪贴板或直接粘贴文本，也支持一行一个 JSON 的文件。
- 查看器里可以搜索：按键名、按值或都搜，可区分大小写、要求完全匹配、只在选中的分支里搜，也支持正则和 JSONPath；文件里写成 中 这种转义形式的中文也能搜到。
- 选中的节点可以复制路径和值，把这一支导出成格式化或压缩的 JSON，对象数组可以导出成 Excel 能打开的 CSV，也能直接生成实体类；文件被别的程序改了会提示重新加载。原来的格式化、压缩、生成实体类等都在「文本处理」页签里。
- 工具工坊新增「🧹 文本格式化」：把换行换成逗号、分号、顿号、点号、空格、Tab、竖线或自定义分隔符，也能反过来一键拆成一行一个；可以去掉首尾空白、去掉空项、去重，给每项加引号，首尾加括号，比如一列名字直接变成 ('张三','李四') 贴进 SQL。

### New

- New Viewer tab in the JSON tool: opens JSON files of hundreds of MB or even several GB in seconds, with a tree view, keyboard navigation and Ctrl+C to copy. Open a file, drop it in, read the clipboard or paste text; files with one JSON per line are supported too.
- Search inside the viewer: keys, values or both, with match case, whole match and search within the selected branch, plus regex and JSONPath; Chinese text written as escapes like 中 in the file is found as well.
- For the selected node you can copy its path and value, export the branch as pretty or minified JSON, export an array of objects as a CSV that opens in Excel, or generate entity classes; you are told to reload when another program changes the file. The previous format, minify and entity tools are in the "Text tools" tab.
- New "🧹 Text Reformat" tool in the Workshop: turn line breaks into commas, semicolons, enumeration commas, periods, spaces, tabs, pipes or a custom separator, or split back into one item per line with one click; trim items, drop empty ones, remove duplicates, quote each item and wrap the result in brackets, e.g. turn a column of names into ('Ann','Bob') ready for SQL.
